description: Linear same-day funnels: each step's visitors (count) and conversion (percent, 0–100, last step over first). Same as GET /api/v1/sites/:id/funnels. Requires Growth; Starter and Hobby callers receive a plan error.

f.description: Optional dashboard filter string, the same as the f query on GET /api/v1.

range.description: Time range: today, 7d, 30d, 90d, or YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD (yesterday is the same date twice). Days follow the site timezone.

site_id.description: Site UUID, as returned by list_sites or add_website.
